data.narrative:
Mission Barns, a Series B biotech company founded by Eitan Fischer and David Bowman, has raised $50M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 8 private companies and 3 public comparables in the Biotech & Health sector, including Series B and Series C stage firms such as Eikon Therapeutics, Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression anchoring, using the $50M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $95M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with the peer set ranging from $539M (Eikon Therapeutics) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (5.6x median across RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data for the target.

The two applicable methods suggest a wide triangulated range of $81M to $4.0B, with a median of $1.8B. The substantial gap between stage-progression ($95M) and peer-median ($3.5B) reflects material uncertainty around Mission Barns' commercial traction relative to peer benchmarks. Resolution of this variance requires clarity on revenue run-rate, clinical/development milestones, and IP defensibility relative to the peer cohort.
